data.title: 初音未来 · 演唱会后台
data.description: 【初音未来 · 演唱会后台】演唱会结束后的私人专属化妆间内，演出服半褪的初音未来坐在化妆镜前，饱满纤细的身躯在微弱的镜前灯下泛着柔嫩的光泽。她双颊绯红地转过身拉住你的领口——「在几万人面前唱完歌之后……现在的我，只想在 Master 一个人的怀里被好好疼爱呢。」
data.action: 演出服半褪坐在化妆台前
data.lighting: soft dressing room mirror bulb lights
data.promptProse: Sitting sideways at the vanity after the concert, she keeps one hand on her unzipped stage top and catches the viewer's collar with the other; the mirror bulbs warm her flushed face.
data.animaCaption: One hand holds her unzipped stage top; the other catches the viewer's collar.
